# Yair Mau — Personal webpage

> Markdown versions of my published papers, made available for LLM consumption.

## Papers

- [Tree Growth, Contraction and Recovery: Disentangling Soil and Atmospheric Drought Effects](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/feuer2025tree): Disentangles soil vs. atmospheric drought effects on Aleppo pine growth using dendrometer data and an irrigation experiment. Yatir forest, Israel. Published PCE 2025.
- [Mechanisms behind facilitation-competition transition along rainfall gradients](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/hollander2026mechanisms): Consumer-resource model explaining when woody plants facilitate vs. inhibit herbaceous growth along precipitation gradients. Published PNAS 2026.
- [Losses Outlast Gains in Northern Hemisphere Tree Growth Under Climate Change](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/feuer2026losses): XGBoost-based analysis of 4,110 tree-ring chronologies shows climate-driven growth losses persist while gains fade under CMIP6 projections. bioRxiv preprint 2026.
- [Dual-Mode Spiral Vortices](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/mau2009dual): Shows spiral vortices in oscillatory reaction-diffusion systems can host a secondary mode at their core, leading to periodic oscillations or a novel form of spatiotemporal chaos. Published Physical Review E 2009.
- [Spatial Periodic Forcing Can Displace Patterns It Is Intended to Control](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/mau2012spatial): Shows that 1D spatial forcing of pattern-forming systems, meant to control stripe patterns, can instead destabilize or displace them via induced 2D rectangular/oblique patterns. Published Physical Review Letters 2012.
- [Monitoring Urban Trees Across the World: Report from the UTEN Inaugural Workshop](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/mantova2024monitoring): Workshop report describing the Urban Trees Ecophysiology Network, a global sensor network studying how urban trees cope with and modify city microclimates. Published New Phytologist 2024.
- [Effects of Population Growth on Israel's Demand for Desalinated Water](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/kramer2022effects): Projects Israel's desalination needs through 2065 under three population growth scenarios, finding population growth effects on water supply will dwarf those of climate change. Published npj Clean Water 2022.
- [Salinity and Sodicity Can Cause Hysteresis in Soil Hydraulic Conductivity](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/adeyemo2022salinity): Soil column experiments show saturated hydraulic conductivity degraded by salinity/sodicity does not always fully recover, introducing degradation and reversibility indices to quantify this. Published Geoderma 2022.
- [Spatial Forcing of Pattern-Forming Systems That Lack Inversion Symmetry](https://yairmau.com/archive/papers-md/haim2014spatial): Weak nonlinear analysis of a modified Swift-Hohenberg equation shows all three basic spatial-forcing resonances (1:1, 2:1, 3:1) have multiple stable phase states, with 2:1 and 3:1 giving stationary phase fronts. Published Physical Review E 2014.
